text: リキせんぱいの　あしを　ひっぱらない　ように　ぜんりょくを　つくします！
note: せんぱい (senpai) is what a junior calls someone senior to them in a school, club or workplace, and the junior is expected to defer to and learn from them. The English game renders it as "mentor".
claim: In Japan, senpai is the term for a senior member of a school, club or workplace, used by juniors (kōhai).

check.quote: Senpai (先輩, 'senior') and kōhai (後輩, 'junior') are Japanese terms used to describe an informal hierarchical interpersonal relationship found in organizations, associations, clubs, businesses, and schools in Japan. ... The kōhai defers to the senpai's seniority and experience, and speaks to the senpai using honorific language.
